description: Als Technisch Product Owner binnen het Platform team bij Realworks help je mee aan het bouwen van een stevig en toekomstgericht platform. Dit platform is de technische basis waar al onze product- en ontwikkelteams dagelijks op vertrouwen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat het platform schaalbaar, veilig en flexibel is, zodat teams erop kunnen blijven bouwen, vernieuwen en verbeteren. Als Technisch Product Owner bij Realworks vertaal jij visie naar échte impact. Je bouwt mee aan een platform waarop ál onze teams elke dag kunnen innoveren. Je zorgt dat het technische fundament van Realworks staat als een huis, vandaag én morgen. Je vertaalt input van stakeholders naar slimme en toekomstgerichte oplossingen. Daarnaast schakel je tussen het grotere plaatje en de details: je vertaalt architectuurvisies naar epics, features en user stories en werkt roadmap-thema’s uit tot high-level designs. Door nieuwe mogelijkheden te benutten, moderne technologieën in te brengen en kennisdeling tussen teams te stimuleren, bewaak je tegelijkertijd de samenhang tussen systemen en teams. Je houdt overzicht in de complexiteit en zorgt ervoor dat alles soepel samenwerkt. Wat ga je doen? Prioriteren van initiatieven binnen de technische roadmap en bewaken van samenhang; Samenwerken met Platform Engineers, Product Owners en development teams; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en introduceren van moderne technologieën en best practices; Organiseren van demo’s, reviews en OpenMind-sessies om stakeholders en klanten te betrekken. Jouw team Je komt terecht in het Platform team en werkt nauw samen met Platform Engineers, Developers, DevOps'ers en twaalf andere Product Owners. In deze rol rapporteer je inhoudelijk aan onze CPO. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen visie en praktijk: je snapt hoe complexe systemen werken én weet mensen mee te nemen in een duidelijke richting. Je werkt in een team waar business en techniek samenkomen en waar jij het overzicht houdt als geen ander. Vereisten Een afgeronde technische hbo- of wo-opleiding of aantoonbare ervaring op dat niveau; Ervaring als Technisch Product Owner of in een vergelijkbare rol; Technisch onderlegd: je hoeft geen code te schrijven, maar je begrijpt hoe systemen en componenten met elkaar communiceren; Ervaring met het werken binnen scrumteams en agile organisatie; Affiniteit met het maken van technische visualisaties en overzichten; Ervaring met agile/Scrum/SAFe werken en het managen van afhankelijkheden over meerdere teams heen; Communicatief sterk en in staat te schakelen tussen developers, architecten en business stakeholders; Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk , en kunt daarnaast goed communiceren in het Engels. Ervaring met solution architecture, system design, Jira, Confluence, CI/CD, DevOps, API-design en integratie, microservices en event-driven systemen is een pré. Wij bieden: Bij Realworks bieden we veel ruimte voor eigen initiatieven en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. We zijn gevestigd in een prachtig kantoor in het hartje van Amsterdam, goed te bereiken met het ov. Je werkt samen met 100+ collega’s in kleine teams, waardoor je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Kom je bij ons werken, dan bieden we je: Work-life balance: Werken bij Realworks betekent het dat je tijd hebt voor werk én voor leuke dingen; Gezonde lunch: Geniet van een heerlijke (gratis) gezonde lunch op kantoor en tank weer helemaal bij; Flexibiliteit is de troef: Ervaar de vrijheid van hybride werken en flexibele werktijden; Amsterdamse Hub: Ons kantoor is gevestigd in het hartje Amsterdam en is gemakkelijk te bereiken met het openbaar vervoer; Reiskostenvergoeding: Geniet van het gemak van een deur-tot-deur vergoeding als je naar kantoor reist; Werkstation: Ontvang de nieuwste laptop, of je nu een fan bent van de MacOS of Windows, zodat je altijd up-to-date en in stijl kunt werken; Onvergetelijke teamuitjes: Geniet van gezellige borrels en teambuilding, zoals Mudmasters, voor onvergetelijke momenten en de leukste kwartaalfeesten; Ontwikkelingsbudget: Geef jezelf een boost met het jaarlijkse budget om verder te leren, zodat je altijd blijft groeien en jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen; De kapitein op je eigen schip: Dankzij onze zelfsturende teams geniet je van veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid; Funbreaks: neem de tijd om te ontspannen tijdens jouw 25-jaarlijkse vakantiedagen; Pensioenregeling: Geen zorgen, we denken aan je toekomst. Realworks spaart voor je pensioen. Hoe ziet ons proces eruit? Solliciteren: Klik op de sollicitatieknop om te beginnen. Telefoonscreening: Maak indruk tijdens een boeiend telefoongesprek. Eerste Interview: Laat je talenten zien en pas binnen het team. Opdracht: Ga de uitdaging aan en toon je expertise. Tweede Interview: Duik dieper in je compatibiliteit met ons. Gefeliciteerd! Je bent een stap dichterbij om een Realworker te worden. Een referentiecheck is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure. Meer informatie? Stuur een Whatsapp of mail onze Recruiter Adriana +31 641285412 or recruitment@realworks.nl
title: Technisch Product Owner

description: We are seeking an experienced EMEA Growth Marketing Manager to scale user acquisition, engagement, and revenue through data-driven marketing strategies. This role will own end-to-end paid social and digital campaign performance — optimising for ROAS, ROI, and overall marketing impact — using AI as the primary toolkit to move faster, test smarter, and deliver outsized results.The ideal candidate is a experienced growth marketer who already uses AI fluently in their day-to-day work — from analysis and experimentation to creative prototyping and workflow automation — and sees AI as the multiplier that unlocks step-change performance gains. Growth Marketing Manager, EMEA Responsibilities: Develop and execute full-funnel marketing campaigns across paid social, search, and other digital channels to drive acquisition, retention, and brand awareness at scale Analyse campaign performance data to identify growth opportunities and optimize marketing spend for maximum efficiency, using AI to accelerate insight generation and surface opportunities faster Explore and experiment with new growth tactics and channels with an eye on CAC, LTV, and scalability — leveraging AI to rapidly prototype, stress-test, and validate new approaches Monitor daily campaign operations and performance metrics, providing actionable recommendations for real-time optimisation and anomaly detection Manage budgets and forecast marketing performance to meet or exceed growth targets, actively adjusting channel allocation and spend based on in-flight data and business priorities Collaborate cross-functionally with product marketing, martech, research, and creative teams to align strategies with business goals Partner with analytics and data science teams to develop measurement frameworks and attribution models Use AI as the default toolkit for day-to-day work — from analysis and experimentation to creative prototyping and workflow automation — while ensuring responsible, policy-compliant use Demonstrate measurable impact from AI-augmented ways of working (e.g., time savings, efficiency gains, faster iteration) and share learnings to scale adoption across the team Stay current with industry trends, tools, and emerging AI capabilities to continuously improve marketing effectiveness Minimum Qualifications: Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product, data science, and operations, to deliver integrated growth programs Preferred Qualifications: Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Knowledge of regional EMEA markets and digital advertising landscapes Track record of scaling AI adoption and sharing best practices across a team or an organisation Comfort operating beyond traditional role boundaries — prototyping, building analysis frameworks, drafting strategy — particularly in ambiguous or fast-moving situations Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context efficiency gains, quality improvements) Proven time management and prioritization ability within a high-velocity, dynamic environment About Meta: Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. description: Your Mission You'll join our product and engineering team at the intersection of customers and code. This isn't a classic PM role — you'll work hands-on with some of the most senior engineers we have, helping build our GPU cloud and inference platform end to end. You'll figure out what needs to be built, talk to the customers using it, and help ship it. We're moving fast on all fronts. You'll have real ownership from day one. What You'll Do Work directly with senior engineers to build and improve our inference platform - from API design to customer-facing features Talk to ML engineers and AI companies using our platform - synthesise their feedback into product decisions Write specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for new features Identify friction points in the product through usage data and customer conversations Coordinate between engineering, GTM, and support to ensure smooth feature launches Contribute directly to the product roadmap - your input shapes what gets built next What We're Looking For You're technically curious and move fast. You're comfortable sitting in a customer call in the morning and reviewing a pull request in the afternoon. You don't wait to be told what to build - you figure it out. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience) First experience in product, engineering, or a startup environment Genuine curiosity about cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML Strong communication skills - you can talk to an ML engineer and a sales lead in the same afternoon Bias toward action: you ship, not just plan Based in Berlin or willing to relocate Why Us? Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups, and top universities Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

description: We're Hiring: Product Manager / Product Owner – Hospital Management Platform (MedOrbit) This is not a "learn healthcare on the job" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals – we need someone who has owned a real HMS, EMR/EHR, LIS/RIS or healthcare-claims product and can take a deep platform and make it sharper, better packaged, and easier to sell. Role Details Position: Product Manager / Product Owner – MedOrbit (HMS & Healthcare SaaS) Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (Hybrid, with regular hospital site visits) Type: Full-time Experience: 5+ years in product, with 3+ years in healthcare software Reports to: Founders Please apply only if you have already owned a live HMS, EMR/EHR, LIS/RIS, or healthcare-claims product used by real hospitals or clinics. About MedOrbit MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One product serves 24 facility types – from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500-bed super-specialty hospital, a pathology lab, an imaging centre, a dialysis chain, a blood bank and a retail pharmacy – sold as 7 commercial editions assembled from 68 licensable modules. It runs the full clinical and operational spine: → Clinical: OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, dialysis, oncology, transplant, cath lab, IVF, telemedicine, tele-ICU → Diagnostics & pharmacy: LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, pharmacy and e-pharmacy → Operations: CSSD, biomedical waste, ambulance, inventory, HR and payroll → Revenue: billing, revenue-cycle management, insurance / TPA, GST, government scheme rates It is ABDM-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4), NHCX-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and carries the Indian regulatory surface: CEA registration and licence tracking, PNDT and NDPS registers, NABH/NABL evidence, DPDP consent and DSAR. And it is AI-native: 11 production agents already run under clinician control – an ambient scribe, pre-consult briefs, consult summaries with draft prescriptions, a result explainer for patients, referral triage, a claim-denial guard, a queue concierge, medication reconciliation, and voice agents on the front desk and in aftercare. The Role You will own the product line end to end – discovery through release – for a platform that is already live with paying facilities. The genuinely hard problem here is not "what feature next." It is productisation: deciding which modules belong in which edition for which facility type, so that a nursing home, a diagnostic centre and a tertiary hospital each receive a product that feels purpose-built rather than a switched-off hospital system. You'll also be the product voice in the sales cycle – joining hospital demos, answering the hard workflow questions, shaping proposals and pilots, and turning what you hear in the room into the roadmap. You'll work directly with the founders and the engineering team, and spend real time inside hospitals watching the workflows you're specifying. What You'll Own → Roadmap & prioritisation across the clinical, operational, billing and regulatory module sets – with a clear, defensible ranking rationale → Edition & packaging strategy – module-to-edition mapping, facility-type presets, entitlement rules, upgrade paths and the commercial logic behind them → Clinical & operational workflows – specifications that a nurse, a lab technician, a radiologist, a front-desk executive, a pharmacist and a billing clerk each recognise as their actual job (~114 distinct roles, each with its own menu and permissions) → Revenue-cycle depth – patient billing, insurance and TPA, NHCX claims, denial management, government scheme rates (PMJAY / CGHS / ESI), GST → Regulatory & compliance requirements – ABDM, NABH/NABL, CEA, PNDT/NDPS, DPDP – translated into buildable, testable acceptance criteria → AI agent product definition – where an agent is genuinely safe and useful, what a clinician must approve, what gets logged, and how we measure whether it worked → Sales enablement – join hospital demos and discovery calls, handle workflow and compliance objections, build demo scripts, edition comparisons and pilot proposals, and feed deal learnings back into the backlog → Customer discovery & validation – hospital site visits, workflow shadowing, pilot design, and closing the loop from production usage back into the backlog → Release readiness – UAT with clinical users, migration and data-cutover planning, rollout sequencing, launch and adoption tracking → The written record – PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, journey maps and decision logs the team can build from without a follow-up meeting What You Must Bring → 3+ years in product ownership / product management, of which at least 3 are in healthcare software – HMS/HIS, EMR/EHR, LIS, RIS/PACS, practice management, healthcare RCM, or a payer/claims platform → You have shipped a healthcare product that real clinicians used in production, and can walk us through a workflow you specified, what broke in the field, and what you changed → Experience supporting sales – you have sat in hospital demos and pre-sales conversations, handled product questions from administrators and doctors, helped shape proposals or pilots, and know how product decisions win or lose deals → Fluency in hospital operations – you know what an OPD token queue, an IPD admission-to-discharge cycle, an OT schedule, a lab sample-to-report chain and a discharge summary actually involve → Healthcare billing and claims literacy – payer mix, TPA workflows, pre-authorisation, denial reasons, package rates → Working knowledge of healthcare data standards – HL7, FHIR, DICOM, ICD/SNOMED – enough to hold your own with an integration engineer → Rigorous written specification skills – this is a platform with thousands of screens; ambiguity is expensive → Comfort with technical trade-offs – you can read an API contract, reason about multi-tenancy and data isolation, and push back on an estimate without being an engineer → Direct stakeholder handling – hospital administrators, doctors, nursing leads, lab heads and finance teams, often in the same room with conflicting priorities Strong Bonus → Indian healthcare regulatory experience – ABDM/ABHA, NHCX, PMJAY, NABH or NABL accreditation programmes → You have taken a healthcare product multi-tenant or multi-facility – chains, franchises, or a white-labelled deployment → Experience packaging a broad platform into editions or tiers (entitlements, feature flags, per-segment presets) → AI/ML product exposure in a clinical setting – ambient documentation, clinical decision support, triage – including how you handled safety, oversight and evaluation → A clinical background (MBBS, nursing, pharmacy, lab sciences) or a hospital-administration qualification → Experience with diagnostic centres, pharmacy retail chains, or government health programmes → Track record of helping close HMS / healthcare SaaS deals or running successful hospital pilots How We Work Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and product decisions are validated in hospitals, not in a conference room. Why Join AI Nexus? ✅ Own the product line of a platform that is already live – your decisions reach real hospitals within weeks ✅ Work directly with the founders; no layers between you and the decision ✅ A product with real differentiation – ABDM/NHCX depth, 68 modules, and 11 AI agents in production ✅ Shape how Indian hospitals, clinics and labs run every day 📩 Ready to Own the Product? Send your resume to: raju@thenexushub.ai Website: https://www.ainexushub.ai/ | https://www.medorbit.ai #Hiring #ProductManager #ProductOwner #HealthTech #HMS #HospitalManagementSystem #EMR #EHR #HealthcareSaaS #ABDM #NHCX #FHIR #RevenueCycle #ProductManagement #Bangalore #Nagarabhavi #Hybrid #StartupJobs #ProductJobs #AIinHealthcare #DigitalHealth #TechJobs Don't just manage a backlog. Own a hospital platform. Shape Indian healthcare.
